_allowImportingTsExtensionsComment: Same reason as core/tsconfig.json: the unit tests here run under `node --test`, which strips types and therefore needs the `.ts` extension to resolve the import at runtime. TypeScript only tolerates that with `allowImportingTsExtensions`, and the flag in turn requires noEmit — already what this config does. Without it, `tsc -p web/tsconfig.json` reports TS5097 on a line that is correct for the runtime that actually executes it. (The note lives OUT here because unknown keys are illegal INSIDE compilerOptions — core's tsconfig says so, and I broke it once before reading my own file.)
